description:
Ask a person to approve a data or schema change in the Quorum app. Nothing runs until they approve it there; it then runs exactly as proposed, once.

The person sees the statement, your reason, the connection and its risk. PROD and CRITICAL changes need them to type a confirmation; some connections need a ticket. Refused outright: read-only connections and statements the safety policy blocks (for example DELETE without WHERE).

Args:
  - connection_id: from quorum_list_connections
  - sql: the exact statement(s) to run
  - rationale: one line on why the change is needed
  - wait_seconds: wait up to this long (max 110) for the decision; 0 returns at once

Returns the request id and status (pending, done, rejected, failed, expired).
name: quorum_propose_write
title: Propose a write for approval
